# StellSec

> Options on tokenized assets, on Stellar. A maker writes a put or a call on an eligible asset and locks the full collateral in a Soroban contract; a buyer pays the premium; the holder can exercise any time before the deadline, and the contract swaps tokens for payment in one transaction. Built at HackMeridian 2026 (Lisbon, Stellar Unlocked track). It runs on the Stellar test network.

The app at https://hackmeridian-psi.vercel.app reads Testnet state without a wallet. Signing uses a Stellar wallet set to Testnet (Freighter, xBull, LOBSTR and others through Stellar Wallets Kit). It is a single-page application with path URLs:

- `/`: what the product is and how one option moves from offer to settlement.
- `/markets`: the listed assets, each with its reference price and its open offers.
- `/markets/<asset>`: one asset, where `<asset>` is a slug (`bond`), `CODE-ISSUER` or the asset contract id. Two modes: guided (pick an outcome: set a floor on a sale price, get paid to sell higher, get paid to buy lower, lock a buy price) and chain (strikes by deadline, the two-sided book of offers and requests). Optional query params select terms: `mode`, `intent`, `expiry` (YYYY-MM-DD), `kind` (put or call), `strike`, `side`, `offer`, `bid`, `ask`.
- `/portfolio` and `/portfolio/<option id>`: the connected account's options, offers and requests, and what is waiting to be done (exercise, claim delivery, reclaim collateral).
- `/requests`: requests to buy (the contract calls them bids). A buyer escrows a premium in the contract and waits for a maker to fill it.
- `/reserves`: collateral locked against collateral held, per token, with contract ids and roles.
- `/issuer`: the issuer console (authorize, freeze, clawback) for the asset issuer account.
- `/learn`: what an option is here, who acts and by when, what can go wrong, and a glossary.
- `/activity`: transactions made from this browser.
- `/margin` and its screens (`/margin/trade`, `/margin/positions`, `/margin/liquidations`, `/margin/vault`): the partial-margin section, a separate contract.
- `/design`: the component gallery of the interface.

Links to the earlier hash routes (`#` followed by `/markets`, `/portfolio`, `/reserves`, `/issuer` or `/pro/...`) are redirected to these paths.

## How it works

- Covered (default): the maker locks the total strike (put) or the total underlying (call) before the sale, and the contract holds it until exercise, the deadline or cancellation. Collateral does not cover issuer action.
- Eligibility is the asset's own trustline authorization, read from its Stellar Asset Contract (SAC). The issuer keeps freeze and clawback; the contract checks those rules, it does not override them.
- Anyone can list a classic asset by code and issuer; the contract derives the canonical SAC. Listing is not eligibility.
- A buyer can post a request: the premium is escrowed in the contract until a maker fills the request or the buyer cancels it, before or after its deadline. After the deadline anyone can also clear it, which returns the premium to the buyer.
- A holder can list an active option for resale at a price they set. Strike, deadline, quantity and collateral do not change.
- Nothing settles by itself: the holder must exercise before the deadline, and the maker claims the delivery or reclaims the collateral afterwards.
- No admin, no oracle, no margin and no upgrade path in the Covered contract.
- Premium is paid to the maker at purchase and is never refunded.

## Contracts (Stellar Testnet)

- [Covered contract v1.5](https://stellar.expert/explorer/testnet/contract/CAIKMS2B4ATWKOKW7BLWQB7Z4JASPZC4EKZ3XL72N7OYSSKKHKW4GKY6): `CAIKMS2B4ATWKOKW7BLWQB7Z4JASPZC4EKZ3XL72N7OYSSKKHKW4GKY6`
- [RWA SAC](https://stellar.expert/explorer/testnet/contract/CCVYWYG56YL7VA7A3EKVJKAKZC4O2B6YXV6UJMERG2NYC7HJHELJLR7U), [BOND SAC](https://stellar.expert/explorer/testnet/contract/CADCBCQ7TU5XCGPYDD32HANAVEWWDARGKIKXWF5YK7NTFOLAWGQYQGHP), [EQTY SAC](https://stellar.expert/explorer/testnet/contract/CDBHRGVHB2NVKJCM5ZKBTUQ3RQHZUZJSSEZLATIUROWXNIEFZ7T7NIFU) (listed at runtime), [USDx SAC](https://stellar.expert/explorer/testnet/contract/CAKXMQVKSW2AEKF5DSMDPHJAYGNVOQANHXLI64QJS2H3GOCXRW2GCICU) (quote token). RWA, BOND and EQTY are issued by one account, so its flags apply to all three: revocable, with clawback enabled. Its authorization-required flag was cleared on 2026-10-26, so new trustlines are authorized automatically (read from the issuer account on 2026-11-11).
- [StellSec Margin (contract crate pro) v0.3.2](https://stellar.expert/explorer/testnet/contract/CBZNS63L23N3Y3GHU6H57AU6OVZ3FOAPM7Z54ATDRC472Q5DWV6UVKCN) (a separate contract): uncovered calls on partial margin, cash-settled in USDx, with a liquidity-provider vault. Prices are published by the team. Payouts can be reduced and any deficit is shown. Shares no storage or balance with the Covered contract.

## Limits

- Collateral does not cover issuer action. A freeze, de-authorization of the escrow or a clawback after a sale can make an option unexercisable, and the premium is not refunded.
- After a clawback the escrow is short for that token: remaining payouts are first come, first served, and new offers, purchases and transfers on it fail until the balance is restored.
- Demo makers are the team's own Testnet accounts. No order-book depth and no pricing model; payoff charts are hypothetical.
- Everything runs on the Stellar test network. The listed assets are test tokens issued by the team's own issuer account; they represent no real instrument and have no monetary value. The contracts have not been audited.

## Optional

- Source code: https://github.com/mohamedkhellaf/hackmeridian
- Stack: Rust and soroban-sdk 28; TypeScript, React 19, Vite, TanStack Router and Query, stellar-sdk, Stellar Wallets Kit; Vitest and Playwright; hosted on Vercel.
